description: This is a Java interface for a repository managing Document entities, extending JpaRepository to provide CRUD operations and includes a custom query method findByProjectId.

classes.name: DocumentRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing Document entities, providing basic CRUD operations and a custom method to find documents by project ID.

methods.name: findByProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Document objects associated with the specified project ID.
